description: This file contains peer helper functions for QuicPacketCreator, used for testing and manipulating internal state of QuicPacketCreator objects in the quic namespace.

classes.name: QuicPacketCreatorPeer
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods to access and modify internal state of QuicPacketCreator objects for testing purposes.

methods.name: SendVersionInPacket
methods.description: Checks if the version is included in the packet header.

methods.name: SetSendVersionInPacket
methods.description: Sets whether to include version in the packet header, with internal version checks.

methods.name: GetRetryTokenLengthLength
methods.description: Retrieves the length of the retry token.

methods.name: GetLengthLength
methods.description: Retrieves the length of the length field.

methods.name: SetPacketNumber
methods.description: Sets the packet number using a uint64_t or QuicPacketNumber.

methods.name: CreateStreamFrame
methods.description: Creates a stream frame with specified parameters.

methods.name: CreateCryptoFrame
methods.description: Creates a crypto frame with specified parameters.

methods.name: SerializeAllFrames
methods.description: Serializes all frames into a packet buffer.

methods.name: SerializePathChallengeConnectivityProbingPacket
methods.description: Serializes a path challenge connectivity probing packet.

methods.name: GetEncryptionLevel
methods.description: Returns the encryption level of the packet.

methods.name: framer
methods.description: Returns the framer object associated with the creator.

methods.name: QueuedFrames
methods.description: Returns reference to the queued frames.

methods.name: SetRandom
methods.description: Sets the random number generator for the creator.
